propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso on binding_store but not on binding_lifecycle, so the clock freeze no longer reaches binding operations moved to binding_lifecycle during RP-02 S2 T2.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its mutation-detection reach has narrowed—it would miss regressions that make clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally.
The unit-tier contract test test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence in test_binding_lifecycle.py pins the no-stamp policy directly, containing the coverage gap at that tier.
Patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle restores the integration oracle's original blast radius for detecting timestamp-stamping regressions.
